parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Hello, Superior Home Appliances, this is Ian here.

Oh, hello, yes. I have a new fridge and I'm ringing to report a fault. We need you to send someone out to have a look at it.

OK. I'll fill in a customer complaint form and arrange for one of our repairers to come out to you.

OK then.

Now, can I just get some contact details from you for the form? Your name?

Jessica. Jessica Brown.

OK. And if I can just get a contact telephone number?

Our home phone number is 5823 2210.

Got it. Now, can I get some more details about the fridge?

Well, it's been playing up since yesterday afternoon.

I see. And is it still under warranty?

Well, I should think so. It's only a couple of weeks old.

That's fine then. Now, I just need to get some more information about the make and model. Is it a top mount, a bottom mount or a side-by-side?

The freezer is on top.

And have you got the model number there?

Yes. It's here on the instructions booklet. It's S654391X.

OK. So it's silver in colour.

That's right. I thought it was so much nicer than the usual white ones.

Now, if I could just get a few details from you. First, when did you buy the fridge?

Well, as I said, it was only a few weeks ago, but I don't have the receipt on me at the moment. I do know that it was delivered on the 6th of February.

OK. Well, I can use that date to search on the computer. Here it is. It says you bought it on January the 12th.

Now, what exactly is wrong with the fridge?

Well, my fridge is fitted with an alarm and it started to go off. It made an awful noise.

So what was wrong?

Well, when I went to check the freezer, it felt pretty warm. It's 10 degrees. It should be minus 18, so everything is melting. And then the main part of the fridge doesn't seem to be working either.

Mmm, I see.

Oh, I've made a note of that on the form and I'll pass it on to the service agent.

When can they come and fix it?

Let's find the closest one to you. Let's see. That's Ken's Appliances and they've got two centres in your area, one near the station and another one in the shopping centre.

Well, we're miles away from the shopping centre, so the station one would be closer.

I'll ring them in a minute, but I should warn you it could take a day or two to get to you.

What? What am I going to do without a fridge? Look, there's a fridge full of food there and it's all going off. I'll have to throw it all out, you know.

Yes, I do sympathise.

It's not just that. This is going to affect my business. I run a sandwich shop and that's where I keep my stock.

Mmm, I see. Look, Jessica, if you tell me how much the stock is worth, we can send you a cheque for that amount, though there is a maximum of $250.

Well, I've just filled it with $180 worth of meat and salad, so that would be something, I suppose. But how long is my business expected to survive without a fridge? It's just not good enough.

Yes, I understand your concerns, but that's all I can really offer you.

Well, I'd like to speak to someone higher up about this.

I can ask my manager to ring you back by close of business today. Would that be acceptable?

Yes, thank you.

I do apologise for all the inconvenience. Is there anything else I can help you with?

Actually, there is one more thing. The door has a dent in it on the left-hand side. It wasn't there in the shop, so it must have happened when it was delivered. I'd like that replaced too.

I'll make a note of that too. you'll be hearing from us very soon.

analyses.content: 虽然客服问的是 top/bottom/side-by-side 三选一，但客户回答说冷冻室在上面（on top），对应的就是 top mount。
Now, I just need to get some more information about the make and model. Is it a top mount, a bottom mount or a side-by-side? The freezer is on top.
你不要死等 "top mount" 这个完整词组出现，要听懂 "freezer is on top" 就是 "top mount" 的同义改写。
OK. So it's silver in colour. That's right. I thought it was so much nicer than the usual white ones.
后面提到了 "white"（白色），那是客户用来做对比的（比白色更好看），不要填错颜色。
客服根据型号推测是银色的（silver in colour），客户紧接着确认说是的（That's right）。
I do know that it was delivered on the 6th of February. OK. Well, I can use that date to search on the computer. Here it is. It says you bought it on January the 12th.
客户嘴里先说的 "6th of February" 是送货日期（delivered），不是买的日期，千万别手快。
题目问的是 "Date of purchase"（购买日期），客服在电脑上查到的记录是 January 12th。
Now, what exactly is wrong with the fridge? Well, my fridge is fitted with an alarm and it started to go off. It made an awful noise.
听到 "noise"（噪音）不要填，那是报警器发出的声音，题目问的是什么东西响了。
客户说冰箱里装了一个 alarm（报警器），然后它开始响了（go off）。
Well, when I went to check the freezer, it felt pretty warm. It's 10 degrees. It should be minus 18, so everything is melting.
"Minus 18"（零下18度）是理论上应该达到的温度（should be），不是现在的故障温度。
题目问现在的温度，客户说冷冻室感觉很暖和，现在是 10 度。
客服给了两个地址，客户因为离购物中心太远，所以选择了靠近 station（车站）的那一个。

Let's see. That's Ken's Appliances and they've got two centres in your area, one near the station and another one in the shopping centre. Well, we're miles away from the shopping centre, so the station one would be closer.
Shopping centre 虽然出现了，但被客户以 "miles away"（太远了）为理由否定了。
It's not just that. This is going to affect my business. I run a sandwich shop and that's where I keep my stock.
只填 "shop" 是不够的，题目通常要求具体的信息，且字数允许，必须把修饰词写上。
客户提到她经营一家 sandwich shop（三明治店），冰箱坏了会影响生意。
...though there is a maximum of $250. Well, I've just filled it with $180 worth of meat and salad, so that would be something, I suppose.
250 美元是公司赔偿的上限（maximum），不是客户实际损失的金额。
题目问食物的价值，客户说她刚装了价值 180 美元的肉和沙拉。
Well, I'd like to speak to someone higher up about this. I can ask my manager to ring you back by close of business today. Would that be acceptable?
不要自己概括成 "boss" 或 "supervisor"，听力填空必须所听即所得，原词是 manager。
客户要求跟上级谈话，客服承诺让他的 manager（经理）今天下班前回电。
Actually, there is one more thing. The door has a dent in it on the left-hand side... I'd like that replaced too.
不要填 "dent"（凹痕），题目是 "replace damaged..."（更换损坏的...），要更换的是门，不是凹痕。
客户最后补充说 door（门）上有一个凹痕，要求把门也换掉。
